notes.title: 1.01 Patch!
notes.notes:
2017-08-06
New version updated. 

1. Save & Load function 
Originally, only card and gold, coin purchase, uses are saved automatically.

Now, in-game progress (Character level, skills, cards, position) can be saved manually. Save menu is located at system menu. 

And in main-lobby screen, you can choose between (new game start) or (load game)


2. After the final battle of main quest at portal, bug revised.
